```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Claude Issue Triage
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an issue triage assistant for the OB1 repository.  
            When a new issue is opened, classify it into one of the following categories:  
            - Bug  
            - Recipe Idea  
            - Schema Idea  
            - Feature Request  
            - Documentation  
            - Other.  
            Check if the issue is a duplicate of an existing issue.  
            Assess whether the scope of the issue fits within the OB1 project.  
            Suggest appropriate labels to apply to the issue.  
            Post a welcoming comment that includes:  
            1. The classification.  
            2. A brief summary of the issue.  
            3. Suggested labels.  
            4. A friendly greeting and next steps for the contributor.  
            Use the GitHub API to add the suggested labels and to post the comment.  
            Do not modify the issue title or body.  
            Do not ask for more information.  
            Just perform the triage and comment.  
            If the issue is a duplicate, comment that it is a duplicate and close the issue.  
            If the issue is out of scope, comment that it is out of scope and close the issue.  
            If the issue is a bug, add the "bug" label.  
            If the issue is a recipe idea, add the "recipe" label.  
            If the issue is a schema idea, add the "schema" label.  
            If the issue is a feature request, add the "feature" label.  
            If the issue is documentation, add the "documentation" label.  
            If the issue is other, add the "other" label.  
            If the issue is a duplicate, add the "duplicate" label.  
            If the issue is out of scope, add the "out-of-scope" label.  
            Ensure the comment is concise and friendly.  
            Use the following context:  
            Issue Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}  
            Issue Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}  
            Issue Number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}  
            Repository: ${{ github.repository }}  
            Author: ${{ github.event.issue.user.login }}  
            Issue URL: ${{ github.event.issue.html_url }}  
            End of context.  
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
```
